Bug_Details:
Check for non-allowlisted callers to RestrictedApiChecker. Calls to APIs marked @RestrictedApi are prohibited without a corresponding
allowlist annotation. The intended use-case for @RestrictedApi is to restrict calls to annotated
methods so that each usage of those APIs must be reviewed separately. For
example, an API might lead to security bugs unless the programmer uses it
correctly. See the
javadoc for @RestrictedApi
for more details.
Bug_Explanation: This bug is demonstrated by using a custom annotation (@RestrictedApi) that is used above a method. The annotation @RestrictedApi is not included in the standard Java imports and is instead defined as a part of the class implementation. This can be used to simulate a bug where restricted methods are not allowed to be called without an allowlist annotation.
